name: atr_breakout_volatility_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: ATR-based channel breakouts (price exceeding N * ATR from a reference level) on 1-min bars capture genuine volatility expansion events. Unlike fixed-point breakouts, ATR channels adapt to each stock's current volatility regime, making them robust across different volatility environments. When price breaks above/below 2.0 * ATR(14) from the session's developing mean, it signals a shift from noise to signal — the move is statistically significant given the stock's current volatility. The inefficiency exists because most retail traders use fixed price levels (round numbers, prior day's H/L) for breakouts, ignoring that the significance threshold varies with volatility.
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹200cr; ATR_14_daily > 1% (sufficient volatility for breakouts)
indicators: ATR_14 = ATR(high, low, close, 14) on 1-min bars
ATR_expansion = ATR_14 / SMA(ATR_14, 60)  # ATR expansion ratio

long.confirmation: breakout bar closes in upper 25% of its range (strong bar close)

short.confirmation: breakdown bar closes in lower 25% of its range

entry.entry_price: market order on breakout/breakdown bar close

exit.target: 3.0 * ATR_14 from entry (1.5x the channel width as continuation target)
exit.stop_loss: price re-enters channel (closes below upper_channel for longs, above lower_channel for shorts) OR 1.0 * ATR_14 from entry
exit.trailing_stop: after 1.5 * ATR_14 gain, trail at 0.75 * ATR_14 from highest/lowest close
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 60 mins without hitting 50% of target
exit.signal_exit: if ATR_expansion drops below 1.0 (volatility contracting), exit — breakout losing steam

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX > 13 (need vol for breakouts); VIX < 25 (not chaotic)
filters.time_filter: best breakout windows: 09:20-10:30 and 13:30-15:00; avoid lunch lull
filters.trend_filter: ADX_14 > 20 at time of breakout (directional movement present)
filters.event_filter: skip if breakout coincides with broad market news event (false breakout risk higher)
other_filters: skip if 3+ ATR channel breakouts already triggered today for this stock (over-traded)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — ATR-based breakouts are adaptive and less subject to parameter decay than fixed-level breakouts

weaknesses: The 2.0 * ATR multiplier is a single parameter with high sensitivity — at 1.5x many more false breakouts trigger, at 2.5x the entry is too late and most of the move is done
On range-bound days (ADX < 20 but briefly spiking to 20+), the ADX filter lets through false signals that mean-revert quickly
Session_mean as the channel center is noisy early in the session (first 30 mins) — channels are too narrow and generate spurious breakout signals
prior_art: Keltner (1960) channels; Wilder (1978) ATR. Modern ATR channel breakouts from Kaufman (2013) adaptive trading systems. Chande (1997) on volatility-adaptive systems.
notes: Edge math: 0.52 * 60bps - 0.48 * 30bps = 31.2 - 14.4 = 16.8bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~7.8bps/trade * 3 trades = ~23.4bps daily. The edge is entirely in the winner:loser ratio (1.55:1); win rate is near coin-flip. Discipline on stops is critical — every false breakout must be cut quickly.
